We respect your privacy. FinArs was designed with maximum data security in mind — most information is stored exclusively on your device.
The controller of the app is the creator of FinArs. For questions about privacy and data processing, contact: finars2026@gmail.com.
2. What data we process and where we store it
All your key financial and business data is stored EXCLUSIVELY LOCALLY on your device. We do not have our own servers and do not collect this information.

string-array.name: privacy_section2_bullets
string-array.item: Financial data and transactions: amounts, dates, categories, comments, and invoice details (including counterparty name and tax ID) never leave your phone.
Warehouse stock: product and stocktaking data is saved only in the app\'s local database.
Receipt photos attached manually to transactions: stored exclusively on your device, never uploaded to the cloud.
Security (PIN / biometrics): the PIN is stored in hashed form in the device\'s secure storage and is never transmitted anywhere.

resources.string: The app uses trusted external services to handle payments and ads:

string-array.name: privacy_section3_bullets
string-array.item: Google Play Billing — handles the purchase and verification of the FinArs Pro subscription. We never see your payment card details (payment is handled by Google).

RevenueCat — once the app is published, will manage the Pro subscription status (active / expired / trial), processing an anonymous user identifier and purchase status to grant Pro access across your devices.

Google AdMob — shows ads to users without an active Pro subscription. AdMob may collect an anonymous advertising ID and diagnostic data to serve ads (subject to GDPR consent collected via Google\'s UMP consent form). Google\'s privacy policy: policies.google.com/privacy

resources.string: The app only requests the permissions necessary for it to work:

string-array.name: privacy_section4_bullets
string-array.item: Camera — required only to scan warehouse barcodes and to photograph receipts.
Notifications — required to remind you about invoice due dates and exceeded limits (e.g. unregistered activity).
Storage — required on older Android versions to save backups and export reports (e.g. PDF / CSV).
Internet access — required only by the ad and billing modules described above; it is not used to upload your financial data.

resources.string: Since your data lives on your phone, you are always in full control: you can clear all data in the app at any time (Settings -> Backup -> Clear data), or simply uninstall the app. You decide yourself where and when to export your backup file.
The app is not directed at people under 16 years of age and does not knowingly collect any data from children.
We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy. Any change will be published here with a new update date.
If you have any questions about privacy or how the app works, contact us: finars2026@gmail.com
